svg.title: CalmSense: stress classification in unseen people
svg.desc: CalmSense primary WESAD chest benchmark. Filter and window recordings, then split by person before fitting. Each of 15 folds uses 14 people for training and validation and one untouched test person. The feature path uses 58 measurements with training-only median imputation and scaling for four classifiers. The CNN uses five processed channels resampled to 1,024 samples, separates inner training and validation people, normalizes on inner training windows, and early-stops on validation. Held-out predictions are scored and combined; summary results are saved. Accuracy is a subject mean; AUROC uses pooled binary predictions. CNN AUROC was not computed. Results are saved 4 October 2026 measurements; no superiority is established among the four feature models.
